hypothesis.class: target-free later-layer Jacobian / activation-region control variate
hypothesis.exact_identity: For q uniform on S^(n-1), E[u^T grad_S g_j(q) - (n-1)(u^T q)g_j(q)] = 0.
hypothesis.derivative: Exact forward JVP through realized ReLU masks; region boundaries have spherical measure zero.
hypothesis.anchor: unit-normalized gradient of summed final antithetic response at q0=ones/sqrt(n)
hypothesis.crossfit: one per-output scalar beta fit on opposite independent Haar block; no ridge/clipping/fallback

measured.beta_status: NaN: frozen per-output coefficient division produced non-finite coefficients

deterministic.reason: NaN values make NumPy array_equal false even when serialized candidate hashes repeat exactly

interpretation.result: The exact spherical-Stein control is mathematically target-free and fits the production budget, but the frozen one-direction cross-fit coefficient rule is numerically inadmissible at production shape: it yields non-finite beta/candidate coordinates.
interpretation.no_rescue: Protocol forbids ridge, clipping, fallback, anchor change, coefficient change, sample change, tuning or rerun. Therefore E109 is terminal.
interpretation.comparison_to_closed_lanes: E106 quartic angular CV and E108 first-layer transport were already terminal; E109 closes this single-direction exact Jacobian/activation-region Stein construction under the frozen coefficient rule.
interpretation.broader_claim: This does not prove that every later-layer conditional-law, Jacobian, or activation-region control variate is impossible.
